claim: Try it with sample data opens a 32-item sample catalog in one click
where: landing primary action, README, demo guide
sandbox: fresh 390 × 844 browser context; assert the primary action is fully in the opening viewport, activate it, and count 32 sample items

claim: Catalog data stays in the browser by default
sandbox: fresh demo browser context; stage a sample edit; assert all requests are same-origin and no real desk session is written

claim: Remote thumbnails stay off until explicitly enabled
where: workspace remote-thumbnail control, README, privacy notice
sandbox: demo entry point with a fixture remote image; assert no initial request, then assert one request only after opt-in

claim: Keeps IDs exactly as supplied
sandbox: demo entry point; stage the item with ID 0001; assert exact patch bytes

claim: Exports a patch CSV for staged edits
where: landing import copy, README, export button
sandbox: demo entry point; stage one location edit; assert patch header and changed row

claim: Exports an undo CSV with original values
where: landing import copy, README, export button
sandbox: demo entry point; stage one location edit; assert undo header and the original location

claim: Demo sample data does not touch real desk storage
sandbox: seed a real-session sentinel; open ?demo=1; reset and exit; assert only demo: storage changes

claim: Works offline after the first visit
sandbox: dedicated fresh browser context; load ?demo=1, wait for service-worker control, go offline, and reload

claim: Desk Plus is a $19 one-time license
where: landing facts, Desk Plus panel, README, terms
sandbox: fresh landing page; assert the $19 offer and hosted checkout route

claim: Desk Plus saves and restores an opened local workspace
where: Desk Plus panel, README, terms, privacy notice
sandbox: mock a verified license; open a CSV review desk before editing; assert local save and next-load restore

claim: License verification happens at most once each day
sandbox: mock license verification; reload within the cached day and assert no second request

claim: A license check sends only the license token in a GET request with an empty body and no catalog content
sandbox: seed representative local catalog content; mock the verification endpoint; assert its GET request has exactly the license query key, an empty body, and no catalog content in the observed request

claim: The app has no analytics, ads, tracking pixels, cookies, or third-party runtime scripts
sandbox: fresh browser context; load and use the demo; assert all requests are same-origin and the cookie jar is empty

claim: Maps arbitrary CSV headings to catalog fields
sandbox: start at the demo entry point, switch to real import, map nonstandard headings, and open the review desk

claim: Reads UTF-8 BOM CSVs with quoted commas, escaped quotes, and multiline fields
sandbox: start at the demo entry point, switch to real import, upload a representative CSV, and open the review desk

claim: Blocks blank and duplicate IDs before patching
sandbox: start at the demo entry point, switch to real import, and assert blank and duplicate-ID recovery messages

claim: Matches local thumbnails by filename
sandbox: start at the demo entry point, switch to real import, attach a local image with the mapped filename, and assert a blob thumbnail renders

claim: Search and filters narrow the visible catalog items
sandbox: demo entry point; search a known sample title and assert only matching item cards remain visible

claim: Staged changes do not modify source rows
sandbox: demo entry point; stage a location edit and assert the undo CSV contains the original source value

claim: Core import, filtering, staging, undo, and export are free
sandbox: fresh unsigned browser; import a one-row CSV, stage an edit, and export a patch without a license
